_comment: KNOWN GAP (2026-08-09), not yet a passing fixture. Two scaling dorks (domain {G,W}) + Breeding Pool + Jetmir's Garden = 6 mana but NO black. Cosmic Spider-Man {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} is payable only via the widening: tap Bloom Tender for {G}, cast Deathrite Shaman {B/G}, the domain gains BLACK, and Faeburrow Elder then taps {W}{B}{G} which with the two lands is exactly WUBRG. The engine casts NOTHING. See docs/design/scaling-source-widening.md.
